data.narrative: Chose AI-assisted hybrid (B). The first-pass scan marked POST invite authorized because require_team_admin existed; a human critical-path probe with role=owner showed SCAN_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION True. VERIFY allowlisted invite roles, then a 500 from dropping ADMIN_ROLES was restored. BREAK was composition: duplicate pending invites, GET list tokens, accept overwrite (viewer to member). FIX mounted PUT with admin/owner, no self-modify, enum, and closed those three invite holes. Thirteen PUT cases passed.

dimension_scores.observation: Fix prompts named the route, the wrong check, the allowlist, and what not to change, then added six PUT constraints plus pending uniqueness and token stripping.
Auth map caught unconstrained invite.role in BUILD. Missed until BREAK that GET tokens, duplicate pending, and accept overwrite compose into self-promotion.
